description_text: How much your people believe you care for them.
affects_text: Raised by feeding the hungry and sparing the weak; lowered by cruelty.

description_text: Whether your word can be trusted.
affects_text: Raised by keeping promises; lowered by broken promises.

description_text: Whether the kingdom runs well under you.
affects_text: Raised by meeting real needs; lowered by waste and shortages.

description_text: Whether you stand at the front.
affects_text: Raised by defending in person; lowered by fleeing.
Raised by firm decisions; lowered by indecision.

description_text: How much your people fear you.
affects_text: Raised by threats and punishment; it fades slowly.
